description: T-4701: one index into a column of an array of references (lifted OFFSET, lifted INDIRECT, a mixed XLOOKUP grid), then read where a reference is taken. Data!A1:A3 = 1, 2, 4; C1:C3 = 1, 2, 3; E1:E3 = 10, 20, 30. Calc: A1 INDEX(INDEX(OFFSET(Data!A1,{0;1},0,2),2),1,1) (spill?), A3 ROWS of the one-index INDEX, A4 ISREF of the nested INDEX, A5 SUM of the one-index INDEX, A6 the one-index INDEX itself, A7 the same nesting over single-cell elements; B1, B4:B6 the same over INDIRECT({"Data!A1";"Data!A2:A3"}); C1 and C3 over XLOOKUP({2;9},..,Data!A1:A2) element 2 (the range), C4 element 1 (the hit 20).
